selection_basis: protocol, access, authority and message-shape diversity
forbidden_selection_criteria: past good calls or any return series
any belief that a source has alpha

rules.rationale: Protocol account whose posts carry program and mint addresses inline, exercising PUBLISHED_MINT extraction on a DIRECT surface.
AMM protocol account posting pool and mint addresses; exercises reciprocal-attestation authority against a project domain.
Aggregator protocol account; posts reference mints via routing announcements, a distinct message shape from a launch post.
Second AMM surface, included so class 1 is not a single-venue artifact and pool-creation shapes can be compared across venues.
Launchpad account; exercises LAUNCHPAD_IDENTIFIES_ACCOUNT authority evidence and high-cadence launch message shapes.
Marketplace/launch surface with a different post template, so launchpad parsing is not fitted to one publisher's format.
Liquidity-launch surface; announcements name pools rather than mints, exercising the indirect-reference refusal path.
Centralised-venue listing announcements; exercises MIGRATED_MINT and the re-listing shape where no address appears in-post.
Second listing venue with a different announcement template and a distinct chain-qualification convention.
Third listing venue; included so migration shapes are not a two-publisher sample.
Aggregator that republishes third-party content, exercising QUOTED provenance scope and propagation collapse.
Second aggregator; duplicate coverage of the same mints is the point, since it exercises the dedupe ledger.
Cross-chain aggregator, so the identity gate sees foreign-chain addresses it must reject rather than only Solana ones.
Registry account posting ticker-first content with addresses often absent, straddling classes 4 and 5 by message shape.
Shape rule, not an identity: surfaces cashtag posts carrying no address, which MUST terminate as TICKER_ONLY and never resolve a mint.

rules.selector: ("just launched" OR "now live" OR "stealth launch") -has:links lang:en
rules.rationale: Second shape rule producing launch-claim posts with no address, so the TICKER_ONLY refusal is exercised on more than one phrasing.

rules.selector: ("official CA" OR "official contract" OR "real CA") lang:en
rules.rationale: Shape rule surfacing posts that ASSERT canonical authority for an address; the authority module decides IMPERSONATOR, not this rule.

rules.selector: ("official account" OR "our new account" OR "we have migrated") lang:en
rules.rationale: Second impersonation-candidate surface; exercises NAMES_DIFFERENT_ACCOUNT where a project's own domain names another handle.
